announcements.headline: Update on Sundae, the Personal AI Agent
announcements.insight: This update follows the October launch of the Personal AI Agent 'Sundae', indicating ongoing operational progress for the platform.

announcements.headline: Launch of Personal AI Agent 'Sundae'
announcements.insight: This follows the August platform update and September subscription launch. It signals progression in the AI agent strategy.

announcements.headline: Grant of Warrants
announcements.insight: Grant of Warrants follows the August placing. This capital action may dilute existing holdings.

announcements.headline: Launch of AI Agent Subscription on sundae_bar
announcements.insight: The AI Agent Subscription launch follows the August platform update and name change. This represents a commercial step in the ongoing strategic evolution.

announcements.headline: Placing and TVR
announcements.insight: A placing follows the August AI platform update and name change, suggesting a capital raise to support the new strategic direction.

announcements.headline: sundae_bar AI Agent Platform Update & Name Change
announcements.insight: Sundae Bar Plc announces a platform update and name change following recent director changes. Shareholders should monitor for further details on how this structural shift impacts operations.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: Sundae Bar Plc has announced a board change. This follows recent warrantholder meetings in May and June 2026.

announcements.headline: Result of Warrantholder General Meetings
announcements.insight: The warrantholder meetings announced in May have concluded. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for any resulting corporate actions or changes to warrant terms.

announcements.headline: Circular Posted & Notice of Warrantholder Meetings
announcements.insight: Sundae Bar Plc is convening warrant holder meetings following its interim results. Shareholders should watch for decisions on warrant exercise or conversion.

announcements.headline: Interim Results for Six Months Ended 31 March 2026
announcements.insight: Sundae Bar Plc has released its interim results for the six months ended 31 March 2026. This is the first such filing on record.
